trends.hook: Labour market expanded in Q3 2026 with stronger employment growth, especially in construction and manufacturing
trends.why_now: Latest advance labour data released 30 October shows total employment grew 27,700 in Q3 2026—double Q2—and non-resident hiring led growth in construction and manufacturing, while hiring intentions improved in September.
trends.source_name: Ministry of Manpower – Labour Market Advance Release 3Q 2026

trends.hook: Employers increasingly selective and holding headcount steady—stronger hiring in Trade & Logistics, Finance & Insurance, and Tech & IT
trends.why_now: ManpowerGroup’s Q4 2026 Employment Outlook (released 8 September) reports net employment outlook at +13%, with nearly half maintaining staffing levels, and strongest hiring intentions in Trade & Logistics (+22%), Finance & Insurance (+20%) and Tech & IT Services (+18%).
trends.source_name: ManpowerGroup Singapore – Singapore Employers Take a More Selective Approach to Hiring … Q4 2026

trends.hook: MOM issues new auto‑fill enhancement for work‑pass applications live from 29 October 2026
trends.why_now: As of 29 October, work‑pass application forms now auto‑populate passport data for applicants with existing FINs, streamlining submission via the myMOM Portal.
trends.source_name: TamaraNews – Singapore Work Pass Changes Take Effect October 29

trends.hook: MOM imposes new Employment Agencies Licence Conditions advisory effective 1 October 2026
trends.why_now: A 28 September EA Alert warns all employment agencies to comply with amended licence conditions taking effect 1 October, including ensuring foreign staff hold valid work passes and avoiding false declarations.
trends.source_name: Ministry of Manpower – EA Alert: Amendments to EALC to take effect from 1 October 2026

trends.hook: Construction hiring lead times to fall significantly from 2027 as overseas skills tests drop
trends.why_now: From January 2027, BCA will eliminate mandatory overseas skills testing for construction foreign workers from China and Thailand, cutting hiring lead times from four months to about one month; rollout to all source countries in 2028.
trends.source_name: Channel NewsAsia – Singapore to shorten hiring time for foreign construction workers from 2027

trends.hook: New PATH initiative gives SMEs access to AI HR help and subsidies from October 2026
trends.why_now: Tripartite Workgroup recommendations (accepted by Government 24 September) include PATH—AI Starter Kits, training, subsidies and playbooks to help SMEs adopt responsible AI in HR; additional $100 subsidy per IHRP certification starts 1 October.
trends.source_name: Ministry of Manpower – Recommendations by Tripartite Workgroup to Strengthen Human Capital in Every Workplace for Every Worker
